sources.entry: SAMA - Next-Gen self-hosted chat server and clients. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) GPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: SAMA is a self-hosted chat server built on uWebSockets.js, offered as an alternative to XMPP-based messaging, with a web and a Flutter client.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes SAMA as a messaging protocol and chat server intended as an alternative to XMPP. It names two clients: a frontend web app and a Flutter app. It documents a REST-style API set covering Users, Conversations, Messages, Activities, Address Book, and Push Notifications, with details published on Medium. The README also explains a multi-node clustering design where nodes discover each other and connect over websockets, using Redis to store node, user, device, and session data. It describes how dead nodes are detected and their Redis data is cleaned up. The README gives no concrete install or run commands; it only has section headings for local development, full deployment, and E2E tests.
use_cases: chat app with web and Flutter clients
notable: Websocket-based node clustering with Redis-backed node discovery and cleanup of destroyed nodes
Alternative to XMPP as a messaging protocol
Ships with a web client and a Flutter client
Documented APIs for users, conversations, messages, activities, address book, and push notifications
caveats: README has no install or run instructions; deployment details are not included in the README text provided
Clustering relies on Redis, which adds an external dependency for multi-node setups
